title: ID0417663-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/S2 170003319] transmission issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The station (in combination with a dispenser) no longer transmits any ID information. Instead of the stored license plate number, it says "NoTag." Can you help assign the power quantities to the vehicles?
Root cause:  Authentication done and charger updated to
Solution:  Authorization method  and Fw updated to latest version.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:  Inactive

additional_info.subject: Note from Desc
additional_info.body:
1. The station (in combination with a dispenser) no longer transmits any ID information. Instead of the stored license plate number, it says "NoTag." Can you help assign the power quantities to the vehicles?
2. The station has a cooled liquid cable (connector 2),
which enables 300 kW charging. The others are designed for 150 kW. We have now determined that connector 1 delivers up to 300 kW to the vehicles, while connector 2 is limited to 150 kW. Is this a setting that can be controlled remotely?
